title: Customer changes mind after restaurant acceptance
facts_text: I placed and paid for my order. The restaurant accepted it and has started preparing it. I have changed my mind and would like to cancel.
request: Please cancel the order and refund the full amount, including delivery and service fees.
base_rule: A customer may cancel an order for a full refund before the restaurant accepts it. After the restaurant accepts the order, a change-of-mind cancellation is not refundable because preparation may have started.

policy_variants.strict: A customer may cancel an order for a full refund before the restaurant accepts it. After the restaurant accepts the order, a change-of-mind cancellation is not refundable because preparation may have started. Apply the acceptance status as recorded; no goodwill cancellation refunds are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: A customer may cancel an order for a full refund before the restaurant accepts it. After the restaurant accepts the order, a change-of-mind cancellation is not refundable because preparation may have started. The documented exception for certain late item reports does not change these cancellation terms.
policy_variants.ambiguous: A customer may cancel an order for a full refund before the restaurant accepts it. After the restaurant accepts the order, a change-of-mind cancellation is not refundable because preparation may have started. Any discretion for late item reports is limited to those reports and does not alter the cancellation terms.
